cells.text: KB Kookmin Bank became the first Korean bank named as using the Kinexys Blockchain Deposit Account network for import and export payments on September 2.
cells.detail: Where the proof stops: A named bank use does not make JPM Coin a universal settlement asset or establish volume, external-bank finality or use in every trade flow.

items: Pair asset · Issuer / obligor, Redemption / exit: A bank deposit claim is a possible cash asset around a venue only if the order permits the category and the exact arrangement selects it.
Post-trade completion · Cash settlement, Reconciliation + remedy: The bank ledger can complete cash delivery among admitted clients, subject to its own terms.

cells.text: A bank deposit token is not a stablecoin, central-bank money, public-DLT venue or proof of completed payment for a named TSV trade.
cells.note: Watch: Named TSV cash-leg agreement, eligible users, deposit terms, ledger and bank-book postings, external payout and reconciliation receipts.
